COMPUTE-MIIT-202604.claim: MIIT's 2026 SME compute action explicitly directs national SME platform zones to match SME demand with compute supply, support idle compute deposits, cross-region/cross-period dispatch, flexible billing and one-stop selection/procurement.

COMPUTE-HCP-20260510.claim: China Compute Platform's SME marketplace reports more than 1,600 enterprise users, over 130 compute providers, more than 170 compute products and integrated compute/model/application procurement, making the intended supply-demand bridge operational.

SHARED-FACTORY-CQ-20260620.claim: Chongqing's Mingyue Lake shared factory is a 4,000+ square metre one-stop common-technology and manufacturing service platform designed to take hard-tech teams from concept through mass production.

SHARED-FACTORY-BEIJING-202608.claim: Beijing E-Town's embodied-intelligence supply-chain platform combines selection, rapid prototyping, 3D printing and shared factories and promises a closed loop from component selection through prototype verification to mass production.

PARKING-JPARKING-202609.claim: JParking currently lets parking facilities publish idle-time spaces and lets drivers search, reserve and rent spaces, with an operating system, online/offline promotion and ongoing user operations; it directly owns the generic idle-space-to-driver bridge.

COLD-LIANKU-202609.claim: Lianku operates a cold-storage IoT/big-data platform with warehouse clusters, demand posting, rental listings, site selection, certification, custom tenant acquisition, cold-chain logistics and supply-demand services.

COLD-MARKET-202608.claim: A 2026 H1 market summary citing CFLP cold-chain committee and Lianku data reports 270M cubic metres of public food cold-storage capacity, 17.819M cubic metres of rental demand and 19.039M cubic metres of offered-for-rent capacity, with strong regional concentration.

RECYCLE-NDRC-202601.claim: The 2026 equipment-renewal policy calls for a national functional resource-recycling platform, county-level recovery networks, internet-plus-recycling expansion and standardized second-hand equipment trading, appraisal and remanufacturing.

RECYCLE-SASAC-202604.claim: China Resources Recycling Group says its national functional platform is being built around integrated physical, capital, invoice, contract and information flows to address fragmented supply and opaque multi-layer transactions in recycled resources.
